DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園のことで何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there a problem with something in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: シャボン玉の液を通路へこぼしました。雨の水たまりではないので、そのまま遊び続けず、片付け方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通路へこぼしたシャボン液を雨水とせず片付け相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I spilled bubble solution on the path. It isn't a rain puddle, so I'd like to ask how to clean it up instead of carrying on playing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you spilled bubble solution on the path, that it isn't rainwater, and that you want advice on cleaning it up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所と、こぼれた物を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where it is and what you spilled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池へ行く通路の曲がり角です。この容器の液です。水を入れる前の物を、半分ほどこぼしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池側曲がり角で薄める前の液約半分と容器を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's at the bend in the path to the pond. It's the solution in this container. I spilled about half before adding water.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, point out the bend toward the pond and the container, and explain that about half the undiluted solution spilled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 清掃担当へ知らせます。こぼれた所の近くで遊ぶのは中断してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll notify the cleaning staff. Please stop playing near the spill.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、子どもも液のそばから離れました。残った液を捨てるために、同じ場所へ追加で流したりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子も遊びを止め残液を同所へ捨てないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, my child has moved away from the solution too. I won't pour the rest onto the same spot to dispose of it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your child has stopped playing and that you won't dump the remaining solution there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 容器の表示も、担当が確認できるよう残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the container label available for the staff to check too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 容器を持っています。透明だからただの水と説明せず、シャボン玉の液だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 透明でも水と説明せず表示付き容器を保持すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the container with me. I won't describe it as plain water just because it's clear; I'll explain that it's bubble solution.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the labeled container and won't describe the clear liquid as water.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 片付けは担当の案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the staff's instructions for cleaning up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 場所と液の容器を示します。勝手に別の洗剤を混ぜて掃除せず、案内を待ってから遊ぶ場所を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所容器を示し別洗剤混合の自己清掃をせず案内を待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show them the location and the solution container. I won't try cleaning it myself by mixing in another detergent. I'll wait for instructions before deciding where to play.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show the location and container, won't clean it yourself by mixing detergents, and will wait for instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。清掃の担当へ状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll explain the situation to the cleaning staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご乗車で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人がここで降りますが、借りた本を返し忘れました。渡すために扉を押さえず、どうするか先に友人と相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 降車した友人への本返却を扉保持で行わず相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend is getting off here, but I forgot to return a borrowed book. I'd like to discuss what to do with my friend first, without holding the doors open to hand it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to discuss returning a book to your friend who got off, without holding the doors open.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本は今、どこにありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 鞄の奥です。友人はもうホームにいます。探している間、扉を開けて待ってもらおうと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本は鞄奥で友人ホームにおり探す間扉待ちを考えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's deep in my bag. My friend is already on the platform. I was thinking of having the doors kept open while I looked for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the book is deep in your bag, your friend is on the platform, and you had considered keeping the doors waiting while you searched.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 列車の扉を止めて渡そうとしないでください。受渡しは無理をせず別の方法を考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please don't stop the train doors to hand it over. Find another way to return it without forcing the handover.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。扉越しに投げることもしません。友人へ後で返すと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 扉越しに投げず別の返却を連絡すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't throw it through the doorway either. I'll let my friend know I'll return it later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you won't throw it through the doorway and will contact your friend about returning it another way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身はこの列車で先へ行く予定ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You plan to continue on this train yourself, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、次の駅まで行きます。本を返すためだけに急に降りず、友人と別の日の受渡しを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次駅へ乗る予定を維持し急な降車でなく別日受渡しを決めると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'm going to the next station. I won't suddenly get off just to return the book; I'll arrange to hand it over another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep your plan to ride to the next station and arrange another day rather than suddenly getting off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出発の案内に従って乗車してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the departure announcements while on board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本は鞄に入れたままにします。友人へ、今日は渡せないので次に会う時に返すと伝えてから席へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本を収納したまま次に会う時返すと連絡し席へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave the book in my bag. I'll tell my friend I can't hand it over today and will return it next time we meet, then go back to my seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the book put away, tell your friend you'll return it next time you meet, and go back to your seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お気をつけてご乗車ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。書類のご相談でお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your paperwork?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書類を提出したいです。さきほど住所の追加情報を口で説明しましたが、用紙にも書く必要があるか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口頭で伝えた追加住所を申請紙へ記入必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to submit these documents. I explained some additional address information verbally earlier, but I'd like to check whether I also need to write it on the form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the additional address information you gave verbally needs to be written on the application form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 用紙のどの欄には、まだ書いていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which field on the form have you not filled in yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 建物名の欄です。受付では名前を言いましたが、紙には番地までしかありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 建物名は受付口頭のみで用紙は番地までと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The building name field. I said the name at reception, but the address on the paper only goes as far as the street number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you only gave the building name verbally at reception and the written address ends at the street number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 口頭で伺ったことと、提出用紙の内容を分けて確認しましょう。建物名は資料で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check separately what you told us verbally and what is on the form to submit. Can you verify the building name in a document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 賃貸契約の控えにあります。聞いたままの略称ではなく、その記載を見て用紙へ書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 契約控え正式表記で建物名を記入したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's in my copy of the rental contract. I'd like to copy that wording onto the form rather than use an abbreviation I heard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to enter the building name using its official wording in your rental contract copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記入する欄をご案内します。ほかにも口頭でだけ説明したことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll show you the field to fill in. Is there anything else you only explained verbally?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡できる時間帯も口で話しました。どの欄へ書くか分からないので、必要な記載か別に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡可能時間も口頭のみで必要欄を別確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I also verbally explained what times I can be contacted. I don't know where to write that, so I'd like to ask separately whether it needs to be included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you only gave your available contact times verbally and want to check separately whether and where to write them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な項目を一つずつ確認してからご提出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the required items one by one before submitting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 建物名を資料から記入し、時間帯の欄も確認します。受付で話したから全て紙に残っているとは思わず見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料記入と必要欄を照合し話した全情報が紙に残ったとしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll enter the building name from the document and check the field for contact times too. I'll review it rather than assume everything I said at reception is already on paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use the document and check the required fields, without assuming all spoken information has been recorded on the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの欄から一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's check together, starting with this field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付の表示で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is something on the reception display confusing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画面の十時三十分を私の診察時刻だと思っていました。でもまだ呼ばれていないので、何の時刻か教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 画面十時三十分を自分の診察開始と思ったため表示意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought the 10:30 on the screen was my consultation time. But I haven't been called yet, so please tell me what that time means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese what the displayed 10:30 means, explaining that you thought it was the start of your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その数字の横には、どんな表示がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: What does it say next to those numbers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 情報更新と書いてあります。私は自分の番号が近くにあったので、その時刻に呼ばれると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 情報更新の語と近くの自番号で呼出時刻と誤読したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says 'Information updated.' My number was nearby, so I thought I'd be called at that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you misread the information update time as your calling time because your number was displayed nearby.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その時刻は表示内容を更新した時刻です。患者さんの診察開始の約束ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is the time the display information was updated. It isn't a promised consultation start time for patients.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。呼出しが遅れていると決めつけず、自分の受付が済んでいるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 更新時刻と知り遅れと断定せず受付済み確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Rather than conclude that my call is delayed, I'd like to check that my registration is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that, knowing it is an update time, you want to confirm your registration without assuming a delay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付の控えを確認しましょう。こちらがご自身の番号ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check your reception slip. This is your number, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、この番号です。情報の更新時刻ではなく、実際にこの番号が呼ばれる案内に気をつけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人番号を示し更新数字でなくその呼出案内を見ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, that's my number. I'll watch for the announcement actually calling this number, rather than the information update time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, identify your number and say you will watch for its call rather than the update time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご不安な点があれば受付へお声がけください。画面の時刻だけで順番の見込みは決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask reception if you have concerns. The time on the screen alone doesn't tell you when your turn will be.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付済みを確認できました。十時三十分は更新時刻と理解して、この番号の呼出しを待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付済確認後に更新時刻と呼出を区別し待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed my registration is complete. I understand 10:30 is the update time, and I'll wait for this number to be called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have confirmed your registration and will wait, distinguishing the update time from the actual call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お呼びするまでこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait here until we call you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご相談で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your concern?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務中の出来事を説明したいです。勤務表の画面を切り抜きましたが、前後の時間が見えなくなったので、元の画面も示したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務表切抜きで前後情報が消え元資料も示したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to explain something that happened at work. I cropped an image of my work schedule, but that removed the surrounding times, so I'd like to show the original screen too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that cropping the schedule removed surrounding information and that you want to show the original too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切り抜いたのは、どの部分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which part did you crop out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の名前の行だけです。他の人の名前を見せないためでしたが、見出しの日付と交代時刻まで消えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他人名保護で本人行だけ残したが日付交代時刻も切ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I kept only the row with my name, to avoid showing other people's names. But I also removed the heading date and the shift change time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you kept only your row to protect others' names but also cropped away the date and shift change time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 説明に必要な情報が分かるよう、元の資料も保存してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also keep the original document so the information needed for your explanation can be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、元の画像は残しています。切抜きだけを一日の全勤務表だと言わず、必要部分を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元画像保存で切抜きを全勤務表としないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I've kept the original image. I won't present the crop as the full day's schedule; I'll explain the necessary parts separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have kept the original image and won't describe the crop as the entire schedule.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どの時間の出来事だったか、覚えていることもお聞きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'd also like to hear what you remember about when the incident occurred.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 交代の少し前です。正確な分は覚えていません。見出しが消えた画像から、時刻を推測して足すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交代直前だが正確分不明で画像へ推測時刻を足さないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was shortly before the shift change. I don't remember the exact minute. I won't guess a time and add it based on the image with the missing heading.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it was just before the shift change but the exact minute is unknown, and you won't add a guessed time to the image.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 元の資料の取扱いは担当へ相談できます。周囲へ広く見せる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can consult the person in charge about handling the original. There's no need to show it widely to others.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当へ、切抜き理由と消えた見出しを説明します。元画像は保持し、前後関係を確認できる形で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当に理由欠落見出しを伝え元資料保持で前後関係を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain to the person in charge why I cropped it and which headings disappeared. I'll keep the original image and consult them in a way that lets them check the context.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain the reason and missing headings to the person in charge, retain the original, and make the context verifiable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。資料を見ながら、状況を詳しく伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll ask about the situation in detail while looking at the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便のご案内でお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with postal information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰り道にポストへ入れたいです。窓口が閉まる時刻までに入れれば今日扱いになると思いましたが、取集の表示も見た方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 窓口終了まで投函すれば当日扱いと思い取集表示確認を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to put this in a postbox on my way home. I thought it would be handled today if I posted it before the counter closes, but should I check the collection notice too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether to check collection times, explaining that you thought posting before counter closing meant same-day handling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用するポストの場所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know where the postbox you will use is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅前です。ここの窓口の時刻だけ調べて、そちらの表示はまだ見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅前ポスト利用だが窓口時刻しか未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's in front of the station. I only checked this counter's hours and haven't looked at that box's notice yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will use the station-front postbox but have only checked the counter's hours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 窓口の営業時刻と、そのポストの取集時刻は別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the counter's business hours and that postbox's collection times separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。窓口が開いている間でも、そのポストの最後の取集が終わっている場合があるということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓口営業中でもポスト最終取集済みの可能性を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Even while the counter is open, the last collection from that box may already be over, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that a postbox's last collection may be over even while the counter is open.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所ごとの取集表示を確認し、日付や曜日にもご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the collection notice for that location, paying attention to the date and day of the week too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は休日なので、平日の欄だけを見ないようにします。駅前の表示を確認してから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休日欄を含め駅前ポスト表示を見て投函すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today is a holiday, so I'll make sure not to look only at the weekday column. I'll check the notice at the station before posting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the station postbox notice, including the holiday column, before posting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お急ぎなら、窓口で送付方法のご相談もできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If it's urgent, you can also ask at the counter about sending methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、ポストへの投函と窓口受付を分けて考えます。営業時刻だけで今日の取集に間に合うとは判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 投函と窓口受付を分け営業時刻だけで取集可否を決めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll distinguish posting in a box from acceptance at the counter. I won't decide that I can catch today's collection from the business hours alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will distinguish posting from counter acceptance and won't judge collection availability from business hours alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。送付方法でお困りでしたらまたご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please ask us again if you need help choosing a sending method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。通帳についてお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい通帳を受け取りました。前の通帳から繰越した物ですが、口座を二つ持ったことになるのか分からなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 繰越新通帳で口座二つになったか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've received a new passbook. It continues from my previous one, but now I'm unsure whether that means I have two accounts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether a replacement continuation passbook means you now have two accounts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回は新しい口座の申込みではなく、使っていた通帳の繰越ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So this was a continuation of your existing passbook, rather than an application for a new account, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、印字のページが終わったので頼みました。でも表紙が新しくなり、別口座を作ったように感じました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 満頁による繰越だが新表紙で別口座と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I requested it because all the printing pages were full. But the new cover made it feel as though I'd opened another account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the old book was full, but the new cover made you think it was a separate account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通帳の冊子と口座を区別して、口座情報を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's distinguish the passbook booklet from the account and check your account information together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前と同じ口座番号です。勤務先へ、給与口座が変わったと伝える必要があると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同番号を確認し勤務先へ給与口座変更連絡が必要と思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's the same account number as before. I thought I needed to tell my employer that my salary account had changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have confirmed the same number and had thought you needed to notify your employer of a salary account change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 口座情報が変わったかどうかで考えてください。新しい冊子になったことだけでは、口座変更ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Consider whether the account information has changed. A new booklet by itself doesn't mean an account change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。古い通帳は過去の記録として、新しい方は取引の続きとして持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧冊は過去記録で新冊は取引続きとして整理すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll keep the old passbook as past records and the new one as the continuation of transactions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will organize the old booklet as past records and the new one as the continuing transactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録の保管について、ご自身で分かるように整理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please organize the records so you can understand how they are stored.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 繰越の日付で二冊を分けます。二つの残高として合計せず、同じ口座の前後の記録と理解します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 繰越日で分け二残高合計せず同口座前後記録と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll distinguish the two books by the continuation date. I won't add them up as two balances; I'll understand them as earlier and later records of the same account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will distinguish them by the continuation date and treat them as consecutive records of one account, without adding two balances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通帳の表示で分からない所はまたお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please ask again if anything in the passbook display is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品のお手伝いはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Do you need help with a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 刺身の盛合せを買いたいです。写真の下に付合せ追加とありますが、写っている大根とは別に注文する物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 刺身写真の大根と付合せ追加が別か確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy a sashimi assortment. Under the photo it says 'additional garnish.' Is that something ordered separately from the daikon shown in the picture?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to check whether the daikon in the sashimi photo is separate from the additional garnish option.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品写真と追加の欄を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the product photo and the extras section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。写真にも大根があるので、追加を選ばないと写真の分までなくなるのかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加未選択だと写真大根も付かないと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. There is daikon in the photo too, so I wondered if even that portion would be missing unless I selected the extra.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought the photographed daikon might not be included unless you selected the extra.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この盛合せには写真の大根が付きます。追加の欄は、さらに量を増やしたい時の別注文です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This assortment includes the daikon in the photo. The extras section is a separate order for increasing the amount further.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら追加なしでお願いします。二人で食べるので、まず写真の盛合せ一つを買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大根込みと知り二人用盛合せ一つ追加なしで注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then no extra, please. It's for two people, so I'd first like to buy one assortment as pictured.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Order one assortment for two people without extras in Japanese, now that you know daikon is included.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。別売りの付合せは選ばず、盛合せだけですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Just the assortment, without choosing the separately sold garnish, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家で皿へ移す時の量を考えたかったので、飾り分も最初から付くと分かれば大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 盛付け量を考える目的で元から付く量の説明で十分と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I wanted to think about the amount when transferring it to a plate at home, so knowing the garnish is included from the start is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you were considering the amount for plating and that the explanation of the included portion is sufficient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに追加したい物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like to add anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今はありません。盛合せ一つに付いている分と別売り追加を二品として重ねず、一つで会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 盛合せ一つのみで付合せ追加を重ねないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not now. I won't duplicate the garnish included with one assortment as a second separately sold item; I'll pay for just one assortment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you want only one assortment, without adding the extra garnish as another item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。盛合せ一つをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I'll give you one assortment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。散歩コースで何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the walking route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園を一周した距離を友人へ伝えたいです。携帯には七キロと出ていますが、朝からの累計なので、公園一周とは分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一日七キロ表示を公園一周とせず距離の伝え方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to tell a friend how far I walked around the park. My phone says seven kilometers, but that's the total since this morning, so I'd like to distinguish it from one lap of the park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask how to explain the distance without treating the displayed daily seven kilometers as one park lap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 公園へ入った時の表示は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember what it showed when you entered the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五キロでした。買い物で歩いた分も入っています。今の七キロ全部を、公園で歩いた距離と言うのは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入園時五キロで買物分も累計に含むと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Five kilometers. It includes the walking I did while shopping. It wouldn't be right to say all seven kilometers now were walked in the park, would it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it showed five kilometers on entry and the accumulated total includes shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その二つの表示を使うなら、差は二キロです。ただし、コースの公式な距離を測ったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you use those two readings, the difference is two kilometers. But that doesn't mean you measured the route's official distance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の表示では入園後に約二キロ増えた、と伝えます。公園の案内に必ず二キロと書いてあるとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人表示の増加約二キロで公式コース距離と主張しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll say that my reading increased by about two kilometers after I entered. I won't say the park's signs necessarily state two kilometers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your own reading increased by about two kilometers, without claiming it is the official route distance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次に同じように記録する時は、開始と終了を区別して残すと説明しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you record it next time, keeping separate start and finish readings will make it easier to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、次回は入る前と出る時の表示をメモします。途中で別の道へ出たら、その分も記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次回開始終了と園外寄道を別に記録すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, next time I'll note the readings before entering and when leaving. If I take another path outside along the way, I'll record that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that next time you will separately record the start, finish, and any detour outside the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 友人が同じコースを歩きたい場合は、案内図で経路も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your friend wants to walk the same route, please check the route on the guide map too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 距離だけでなく、私が歩いた経路も伝えます。一日累計と公園内の増加分、案内のコース距離を分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 歩行経路と累計園内増加公式距離を区別して友人へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell them the route I walked as well as the distance. I'll distinguish the day's accumulated total, the increase inside the park, and the signed route distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain the route to your friend and distinguish the total, the park increase, and the official distance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの案内図もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please look at this guide map too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お荷物のことでお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この空いているロッカーにスーツケースを入れましたが、扉が閉まりません。まだ払っていないので、入れ方を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未払いのロッカーに荷物を入れたが扉が閉まらず入れ方を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put my suitcase in this empty locker, but the door won't close. I haven't paid yet, so could you check how I've put it in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that the locker door won't close with your luggage inside, that you haven't paid, and ask someone to check its placement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず扉を押さず、お荷物を一度出しましょう。伸ばしている取っ手は収納できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, don't push the door; let's take your luggage out once. Can you retract the extended handle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、今しまいました。ただ、本体が入口から少し出ています。取っ手だけが原因ではなかったようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 取っ手を収納しても本体がはみ出すため取っ手だけの問題ではないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I've just put it away. But the suitcase body still sticks out a little at the opening. It seems the handle wasn't the only problem.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that the body still protrudes after retracting the handle, so the handle isn't the only problem.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本体の奥行きも、この庫には合わないようですね。隣の大きい庫を確認してみますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It seems the depth of the suitcase doesn't fit this compartment either. Would you like to check the larger one next to it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。横向きにして無理に押すより、大きい方で扉までの余裕を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小さい庫へ押し込まず大きい庫で扉までの余裕を確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. Rather than turn it sideways and force it in, I'd like to check the clearance to the door in the larger one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to check door clearance in a larger locker instead of forcing the suitcase into the smaller one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは現在空いています。中に入れて、荷物が扉の動きを妨げないか確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This one is currently empty. Put it inside and check that the luggage doesn't obstruct the door's movement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入りました。取っ手をしまった状態で、扉の内側にも余裕があります。財布は取り出して、自分で持っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大きい庫に収まり扉を妨げず財布は手元へ取り出したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It fits. With the handle retracted, there's clearance inside the door too. I'll take out my wallet and keep it with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that it fits the larger compartment without blocking the door and that you have taken out your wallet to keep with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それではこちらの庫の料金と、利用時間の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Now please check this compartment's fee and the displayed usage hours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 料金と時間を読みました。今回は大きい方を使います。小さい庫の扉を押して閉めず、こちらの手順で預けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料金と時間を確認し大きい庫を案内の手順で利用すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've read the fee and hours. I'll use the larger one this time. I won't force the small locker door closed; I'll store my luggage here following these steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have checked the fee and time and will use the larger locker following the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの案内に沿ってご利用ください。お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please follow these instructions. Have a safe outing.
